    Train a gene-specific classifier from LEMUR neighborhoods

    train_classifier.Rd

    Trains a logistic regression classifier to predict LEMUR neighborhood membership for a given gene. The classifier uses gene-level differential expression and the LEMUR embedding as predictors. Principal component analysis is applied to the predictors, retaining the components explaining more than 90% of the total variance.

    train_classifier(pred_train, nei_train, gene_name)

    Arguments

    pred_train

    A training SingleCellExperiment object containing the differential-expression matrix and LEMUR embedding.

    nei_train

    A data frame containing the LEMUR neighborhoods. Must contain a name column identifying genes and a neighborhood column containing the corresponding cell sets.

    gene_name

    Character string specifying the gene for which the classifier is trained.

    Value

    A list containing:

    fit

    The fitted binomial logistic regression model.

    pca

    The PCA object fitted to the predictors.

    k

    The number of principal components retained, explaining more than 90% of the total variance.
